title: Remote Codex session turn fails with 'Error running remote compact task: workspace routing discovery unauthorized (401)' after a recovered connection
outcome: The cause of the 401 on a remote Codex session's compact task is identified with evidence: either a Codex provider authorization or workspace issue on the remote machine, or a TermAl defect in how remote sessions carry provider authorization. If it is TermAl's, it is fixed so that a recovered remote session can compact without re-pairing or manual reconciliation. If it is the provider's, TermAl surfaces it as a typed provider-authorization failure with a recovery hint, not as an opaque failed turn.
acceptance: A cause note with evidence names the host and session, shows the message's origin as Codex runtime or TermAl with file:line where it is TermAl's, and states whether the provider authorization for that machine's Codex home was valid at 16:53:34Z.

If TermAl is at fault: a fix with deterministic tests makes a remote Codex session that recovers its connection keep valid provider authorization for compaction, with no re-pairing or manual reconciliation.
If the provider is at fault: TermAl reports the failure as a typed provider-authorization error naming the host and the recovery action, covered by a test, instead of an untyped failed turn.
